processing.slope: GDAL Horn, degrees, horizontal and vertical units metres, scale=1
processing.zonal_statistics: Exact raster-pixel intersection area weighted for each transformed existing LCC grid polygon
processing.percent_slope: 100 * tan(slope_degrees); mean_pct is area-weighted mean of pixel percent slopes, not tan(mean_deg)
processing.raster_cutline: Pixel-centre raster mask; polygons and CSV use exact vector intersection areas

arcgis_usage.purpose: Satellite/aerial background only; no slope computation or slope values from ArcGIS
arcgis_usage.reason: Provides a georeferenced image for the study bounds, consistent with the Esri background in the existing Hallasan map
arcgis_usage.credit: Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
arcgis_usage.image_dates: Mixed mosaic; acquisition dates not verified. Display only.

vworld_findings.analysis: Public page samples terrain heights in the client; screenshot distributions do not identify georeferenced slope polygons

grid.original_crs: Assumed spherical LCC, standard parallels 30/60, radius 6371008.77m
grid.area_difference: Projection-scale difference. Same geographic footprint; original assumed LCC metres differ from UTM ground-scale area.

limitations: DSM includes vegetation and structures; not a bare-earth survey DTM.
30m sampling smooths small cliffs and trail-scale features; resampling does not increase source detail.
These values are not equivalent to VWorld terrain or its browser analysis method.

Entire rectangular reference grid retained; some coastal-edge cells include water. No authoritative land/water mask was applied; near-zero surface heights and water slopes must not be interpreted as land-only terrain statistics.
Full geographic raster coverage means no missing computational samples, not verified terrain accuracy.
OSM routes represent 6 reference courses; Seokgulam geometry absent; full official course coverage unverified.
No rainfall data, weather API, authentication key, or hiking safety classification used.

files.shapefiles/slope_classes.shp: Contiguous 30m slope-class polygons clipped to study boundary
files.hallasan_slope.qgs: Portable QGIS project using relative local paths
files.hallasan_slope_satellite.png: Satellite/aerial backdrop with slope classes and reference trails
